Class StartMenuController

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.controller.StartMenuController
public class StartMenuController extends Object
Handles the start-menu actions: starting a new game and loading an existing save. Both operations produce a fully initialised GameController that views can use for the active session.

    • getSaveOptions

    • getDatasetOptions

      public List<String> getDatasetOptions()
      Returns the names of all available exchange datasets so the view can list them. The .csv extension is stripped so the names can be passed directly to startNewGame(String, BigDecimal, Difficulty, String, String).
      Returns:
      list of dataset base-names (without extension) inside resources/datasets

    • startNewGame

      public GameController startNewGame(String playerName, BigDecimal startingMoney, Difficulty difficulty, String datasetName, String saveSlot)
      Creates a brand-new game session from the given parameters.
      Parameters:
      playerName - the name chosen by the player
      startingMoney - the amount of money the player starts with
      difficulty - the chosen difficulty level
      datasetName - the dataset filename (without extension) to load the exchange from
      saveSlot - the save-folder name to use when saving this session
      Returns:
      a GameController ready to use

    • getSavesRanked

      public List<StartMenuController.SaveSummary> getSavesRanked()
      Returns all save slots with their computed scores, sorted by score descending. If a save cannot be loaded or scored it is still included with a score of zero, so it always appears last.
      Returns:
      save summaries sorted highest score first

    • loadGame

      public GameController loadGame(String saveSlot)
      Loads an existing save and returns a ready-to-use game session.
      Parameters:
      saveSlot - the save-folder name to load from
      Returns:
      a GameController restored from the save files
